LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Farmer.title: river farmer
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Farmer.description: Every year [PAWN_nameDef] waited for the flood, then planted the black silt it left behind. [PAWN_pronoun] knows the weight of a good harvest by eye and the taste of a bad one by heart.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Scribe.title: royal scribe
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Scribe.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sat cross-legged in the granary for years, counting sacks, copying letters and catching overseers who stole. Many people owe [PAWN_objective] favours; some owe [PAWN_objective] grudges.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Mason.title: royal stonemason
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Mason.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked in the quarry gangs that cut and dragged the great blocks. [PAWN_pronoun] can split granite with wooden wedges and water, and [PAWN_possessive] walls never lean.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Medjay.title: medjay scout
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Medjay.description: [PAWN_nameDef] patrolled the desert roads with the medjay, tracking thieves across rock and sand. [PAWN_pronoun] can run all day and still shoot straight at sunset.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Charioteer.title: charioteer
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Charioteer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] drove a war chariot in the king's corps, a pair of horses in one hand and a bow in the other. [PAWN_pronoun] still talks to animals more gently than to people.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Physician.title: house of life physician
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Physician.description: In the House of Life [PAWN_nameDef] learned to set bones, stitch wounds and read the old medical papyri, which are right more often than people expect.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Boatman.title: river boatman
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Boatman.description: [PAWN_nameDef] poled cargo barges up and down the river, carrying grain north and stone south. [PAWN_pronoun] knows every sandbank and every tavern on the way.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Merchant.title: incense trader
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_Merchant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] led donkey caravans to the southern lands for incense, ebony and ostrich feathers, and came back with all of them and most of [PAWN_possessive] donkeys.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_ScribeSchool.title: scribe school pupil
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_ScribeSchool.description: [PAWN_nameDef] copied the same proverbs onto pottery shards a thousand times while the teacher walked behind [PAWN_objective] with a stick.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_ReedChild.title: reed cutter
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_ReedChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the marshes, cutting reeds for papyrus and boats and keeping one eye open for crocodiles.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_PotterChild.title: potter's child
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_PotterChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kneaded clay and fed the kiln in a potter's yard, making the jars that carried the whole kingdom's beer and grain.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_DesertChild.title: desert-edge herder
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_BS_DesertChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] herded goats where the green fields end and the red sand begins, and learned to find water where there seemed to be none.
